tutorial.name: Make a Robot Arm Feel Weightless with Holoscan 5
tutorial.description: Use HSDK 5.0, part of the Holoscan 5 platform release, to build a low-latency gravity-compensation loop for a Seeed Studio reBot arm with Pinocchio in Python or C++, then measure latency and jitter with Nsight Systems

hardware.name: Seeed Studio reBot Arm B601-DM
hardware.description: Six-joint arm and gripper with Damiao motors, power supply, and serial connection

hardware.name: Linux host with serial device access
hardware.description: x86_64 Ubuntu 24.04 or Jetson Orin Nano / Jetson Thor with JetPack 7.2.1; read/write access to the arm's serial device
